title: A Variational Formulation of Classical Cosserat Elasticity with Independent Coframe and Rotational Connection
summary: We present a geometric formulation of classical Cosserat elasticity in which the coframe and rotational connection are treated as independent variational fields. In contrast to conventional metric-based approaches, this formulation makes the underlying geometric structure explicit and separates translational and rotational degrees of freedom at the level of the action.
